card.intuition: The shared understanding of what is being built, held in common between user and agent but separate from any asset: the conversation, handoff artifacts, and the code all try to capture it, but none of them are it. When the agent writes exactly what you asked and it is still wrong, you did not yet have a whole design concept to share, so it filled your silences with assumptions. You can tell it is shared when the agent answers questions you have not asked yet the way you would.
card.analogy: Like two builders agreeing on a house: the sketches and the material list are assets that describe the plan, but the plan itself lives in their shared heads; if one builder was never told about the pantry, no sketch mentions it, so they fill in a closet where the pantry goes.
card.time_complexity: Operational cost falls later once the concept is shared, but alignment itself costs conversation: each clarifying exchange adds human latency, and each agent answer adds inference cost per request until the silences close.
card.space_complexity: Context footprint grows with the conversation that builds it: a long back-and-forth accumulates in the context window, and assets that lag the moving concept risk attention degradation or compaction.
when_to_use: Before letting the agent write a spec, so the spec does not capture misalignment in a durable asset
When the agent writes exactly what you asked and it is still wrong
Through grilling, the deliberate version of the alignment conversation
gotchas: Writing a spec too early just captures the misalignment in a more durable asset
The design concept moves as you learn, and assets lag it, so a faithful spec can still mislead a later session
A prompt captures the parts you worked out and is silent on the parts you had not

steps.label: Unformed
steps.annotation: You have not fully worked out what you want.

steps.label: Silences
steps.annotation: The prompt captures the worked-out parts and nothing else.

steps.label: Assumptions
steps.annotation: The agent quietly fills the gaps with its own guesses.

steps.label: Mismatch
steps.annotation: The output is faithful to the prompt yet wrong on intent.

steps.label: Align
steps.annotation: Conversation raises the concept before any asset is written.

exercise.prompt: Model a shared design concept: the plan is aligned only when the agent answers every settled decision the way you would.
hints: Alignment means the agent's default fills the gaps the way you would.
Any mismatch on a settled decision means the concept is not yet shared.
exercise.test_code:
qs = [{"asked": True, "key": "refund", "expected": True}]
assert has_shared_design_concept({"refund": True}, qs) is True
assert has_shared_design_concept({"refund": False}, qs) is False
qs2 = [{"asked": False, "key": "refund", "expected": False}]
assert has_shared_design_concept({}, qs2) is True
print('PASS')
